svg.title: Intent becomes state.
svg.desc: Separate request acceptance from convergence, and see why the controller checks ownership and versions again. Illustrative flow, not live telemetry.

g.text: Accepted means persisted. Ready comes later.
Illustrated happy path and blocked branch; retries are not timed telemetry.
